Name: CP Rainy Days
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
A CP, 1.6-friendly update to BritneyMc0206's mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2521]CM Rainy Days Fan-Song[/url], which adds [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCjvrRp5J06REgUd91u8Xl3Q]Adam Haynes[/url] song Rainy Days to...well, rainy days. Converted to CP since Custom Music is now obsolete. Uploaded with permission from BritneyMc0206.

As of 1.1 there are two track options: One with vanilla rain sounds and one without. USE ONLY ONE

Enjoy!
